dossier.headline: Air Max 95 Toddler Phantom Tattoo
dossier.summary: The Nike Air Max 95 in Baby/Toddler sizing, colorway Phantom/Tattoo/Moon Particle/Silt Red, style code 905462-012. It carries the iconic Air Max 95 design with breathable mesh, synthetic leather layering, and visible Max Air cushioning, reissued for young children as a casual lifestyle sneaker.

facts.label: Cushioning
facts.value: Visible Max Air units, foam midsole

story.title: A '90s Icon, Toddler-Sized
story.detail: Nordstrom frames the Air Max 95 as a '90s-throwback sneaker reissued for sporty little feet, sold in walker, toddler and little kid sizing. The chunky retro silhouette carries its recognized 1990s design lineage.

story.title: Inspired by the Human Body
story.detail: Nike states the model's wavy panels and sculpted foam outsole are inspired by the human body, resembling muscles and a spine. Visible Max Air units provide lightweight cushioning.

story.title: A Soft-Toned Gradient
story.detail: Sneaker coverage describes Phantom suede fading into red Tattoo on lower layers, with Moon Particle and Silt Red across eyelets and branding, a white midsole and reflective metallic silver on the spine.

references.title: Air Max 95 Recraft (Kids)
references.detail: Parallel toddler and preschool Air Max 95 Recraft models combine real and synthetic leather with mesh, sharing construction cues with this pair.

references.title: Phantom/Tattoo GS Colorway
references.detail: The grade-school Air Max 95 in the same Phantom/Tattoo palette confirms this as a kids-exclusive color scheme.

references.title: Little Kids' Air Max 95
references.detail: The closely related little kids' pair in the same palette lists Country of Origin as Vietnam.
